### 2. `Directory.Build.targets` — Unconditional property overrides kill project-level opt-outs

**File**: `Directory.Build.targets:6-11`

`TreatWarningsAsErrors`, `Company`, `Authors`, and `Copyright` are set **unconditionally** in `.targets`. Because `.targets` is imported *after* the project file, these override any value set in a `.csproj`. This directly causes **LibB's `<TreatWarningsAsErrors>false</TreatWarningsAsErrors>` to be silently ignored**.

Default-style properties belong in `.props` (imported *before* the project, so project-level values win). Only enforcement overrides belong in `.targets`.

**BAD** (current — in `Directory.Build.targets`):
```xml
<PropertyGroup>
  <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  <Company>Contoso</Company>
  <Authors>Build Team</Authors>
  <Copyright>Copyright 2024 Contoso</Copyright>
</PropertyGroup>
```

**GOOD** (move to `Directory.Build.props` as defaults):
```xml

<PropertyGroup>
  <TreatWarningsAsErrors Condition="'$(TreatWarningsAsErrors)' == ''">true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  <Company Condition="'$(Company)' == ''">Contoso</Company>
  <Authors Condition="'$(Authors)' == ''">Build Team</Authors>
  <Copyright Condition="'$(Copyright)' == ''">Copyright 2024 Contoso</Copyright>
</PropertyGroup>
```

**BAD**:
```xml

  <DefineConstants>ENABLE_LOGGING</DefineConstants>
</PropertyGroup>
```

**GOOD**:
```xml

  <DefineConstants>$(DefineConstants);ENABLE_LOGGING</DefineConstants>
</PropertyGroup>

- Race conditions on shared output files (intermittent `IOException` / corrupted outputs)

**BAD**:

</Target>
```

**GOOD** (use `DependsOnTargets` to run in the same project instance):

**BAD**:

  <Compile Include="Domain.fs" />     <!-- must come first -->
  <Compile Include="Program.fs" />
</ItemGroup>
```

**GOOD** (matches `OrderService.fsproj` which has the correct order):
```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <Compile Include="Domain.fs" />
  <Compile Include="Services.fs" />
  <Compile Include="Program.fs" />
</ItemGroup>
```

  </Reference>
</ItemGroup>
```

**GOOD**:
```xml

  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

**File**: `LibA/LibA.csproj:13`

The condition `$(Configuration) == Debug` is missing quotes. If `Configuration` is ever empty, this evaluates as ` == Debug` which MSBuild may parse unexpectedly. Always quote both sides.
